51575500.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to C-terminal domain human Gal-8 expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) cells by isothermal titration calorimetry analysis
51575500.references_previous: Zetterberg, F. R.; MacKinnon, A.; Brimert, T.; Gravelle, L.; Johnson, R. E.; Kahl-Knuttson, B.; Leffler, H.; Nilsson, U. J. Monosaccharide derivatives with low-nanomolar lectin affinity and high selectivity based on combined fluorine-amide, phenyl-arginine, sulfur-pi, and halogen bond interactions. ChemMedChem. 2018, 13, 133–137.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: The binding affinities of compounds 53, 55, and 57 toward gal-3 and gal-8C were measured by isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) as described previously.17 The experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical, Worcestershire, U.K.). The protein solutions (gal-3 or gal-8C, 100 μM) were prepared in 20 mM HEPES (pH 7.4) containing 150 mM NaCl and 0.02% NaN3. The ligand solutions (1–2 mM) were prepared in the same buffer. The protein solution was loaded into the sample cell, and the ligand solution was loaded into the syringe. The experiments were conducted at 25 °C with a stirring speed of 750 rpm. A total of 20 injections were performed, each of 2 μL, with a spacing of 120 s between injections. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab, Northampton, MA, U.S.A.) with a one-site binding model. The reported Kd values are the mean ± SEM of at least three independent experiments.

51575497.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human Gal-3 expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) cells by isothermal titration calorimetry analysis
51575497.references_previous: Zetterberg, F. R.; MacKinnon, A.; Brimert, T.; Gravelle, L.; Johnson, R. E.; Kahl-Knuttson, B.; Leffler, H.; Nilsson, U. J. Monosaccharide derivatives with low-nanomolar lectin affinity and high selectivity based on combined fluorine-amide, phenyl-arginine, sulfur, and halogen bond interactions. ChemMedChem. 2018, 13, 133–137.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: The binding affinity of compounds 53, 55, and 57 toward gal-3 and gal-8C was measured by isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) as described previously.17 The experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical, Worcestershire, U.K.). The protein (gal-3 or gal-8C) was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES (pH 7.4) and 150 mM NaCl, and then concentrated to 100 μM. The ligand (compound 53, 55, or 57) was dissolved in DMSO and diluted with the dialysis buffer to a final concentration of 1.0 mM. The protein was loaded into the sample cell (200 μL), and the ligand was loaded into the syringe (250 μL). The titration was performed at 25 °C with 20 injections of 2.0 μL each, spaced 180 s apart. The stirring speed was set to 300 rpm. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab, Northampton, MA) with a one-site binding model. The reported Kd values are the mean ± SEM of at least three independent experiments.
